Hey everyone, just wanted to get a starting point for everyone to discuss the upcoming draft. I though I'd start with some of the prospects I like from this year:

  • DeVante Parker: He's (and White) my favorite receivers from this draft. No disrespect to Cooper I think he's a great prospect as well, I just really enjoy how Parker finds seperation, has good speed, and is pretty tall. Obviously he has injury concerns, but I'd love for the Niners to take him at 15.

  • Marcus Peters: He can be very agressive in his coverage, quick enough to recover if beaten (although he sometimes gets fooled very badly and can't recover), very good ball awareness, and knows what his job on the field is.

  • DGB: Again with the big WR facisination. I really wish he could've played this year, I really feel like he would've been a top 10 pick easily. He's strong, he's big, and has pretty good speed for a 6'5" guy. Some things to work on are his route running. He can round off routes sometimes and doesn't sell well making the catch harder for him, relying on his athleticism more.

  • Jeremy Langford: Maybe it's his division, but I really like this guy. He doesn't do anything spectacularly, but at the same time he's good at almost everything. Blitz pickup, patience for a whole to show up, receiving out of the backfield, you name it. He made huge improvements from his Junior to Senior season, most notably putting on weight to power the football downfield (although he showed during the combine he still had some speed with a 4.42 40 and a pretty good 7.22 3 cone drill)

Anyways, I'd like to hear your thoughts.
